page: Microsoft Azure FX48-12mds_v2 is an x86_64 architecture server belonging to the FXmdsv2 family, virtualized via Microsoft Hyper-V. It features 12 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon 8573C processor running at 4.2 GHz, with 6 physical cores and 2 threads per core. The processor includes a 260 MB L3 cache and supports advanced instruction sets such as AVX-512 and Intel AMX for deep learning operations. The server is equipped with 1008.0 GB of RAM, yielding a high memory-to-core ratio of 84.0 GB per core. Local storage consists of a 2835 GB NVMe SSD, and the instance is Premium Storage capable. No GPUs or complimentary public IPv4 addresses are included.

Benchmark data indicates strong single-threaded performance, with a Geekbench single-core score of 2365.0 and a text processing score of 2927.0, both placing in the top 10% tier. Single-threaded gzip compression at 34.55 GB/sec and bzip3 decompression at 14.47 GB/sec rank in the top 25%. Multi-core and multi-threaded metrics generally align with the middle 50% average, including a Geekbench multi-core score of 11420.0 and a stress-ng multi-core CPU performance of 13318.5. Memory bandwidth tests show 1033.73 GB/sec for cached small blocks and 102.55 GB/sec for uncached large blocks. For lightweight machine learning workloads, the server achieves a strong text generation speed of 269.27 tokens/sec using a small 135M parameter model.

Given the high memory density of 1008.0 GB alongside a relatively low vCPU count of 12, this server offers qualitative cost efficiency for memory-bound workloads that do not require massive parallel CPU scaling. The inclusion of a 2835 GB local NVMe SSD provides high-speed local scratch space. Tradeoffs include average multi-core processing scaling relative to its massive memory footprint. This configuration is suitable for large in-memory databases, caching layers, memory-intensive data processing, and enterprise applications requiring high RAM capacity per processor core.
description: The Microsoft Azure FX48-12mds_v2 is a memory-optimized server from the FXmdsv2 family, virtualized via Microsoft Hyper-V on the x86_64 architecture. It features 12 dedicated vCPUs from an Intel Xeon 8573C processor running at 4.2 GHz, 1008.0 GB of RAM, and a 2835 GB local NVMe SSD. Single-core performance is notable, with Geekbench single-core and text processing scores reaching the top 10% tier, while multi-core benchmarks align with the middle 50% average. The server lacks GPU accelerators. This hardware profile, combining massive memory capacity with a moderate CPU count and fast local storage, is designed for memory-intensive workloads, including large-scale in-memory databases, caching systems, and data processing tasks that require high memory-to-core ratios without requiring massive parallel compute scaling.
